source.test: A. prog/opt-stabilization: every literal the evaluator read shows its number in the description

ret: 1 training day (A) holding 2 exercises, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A, then Day A, then Day A.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
Day A: a circuit of pushStab and squatStab, resting 90 s between rounds.

pushStab: 2 sets of 12 reps to 20 reps at a slow tempo, on the current rung of Push-Up, Hands on Stability Ball, then Alternating DB Chest Press on Ball, then Single-Leg Standing Cable Press, starting from 0; climb a rung after 2 sessions in a row with every set done and solid form, up to rung 2.

squatStab: 2 sets of 12 reps to 20 reps at a slow tempo, on the current rung of Ball Wall Squat, then Single-Leg Squat, then Single-Leg Squat on Foam Pad, starting from 0; climb a rung after 2 sessions in a row with every set done and solid form, up to rung 2.

ret: 2 sets of 12 reps to 20 reps at a slow tempo, on the current rung of Push-Up, Hands on Stability Ball, then Alternating DB Chest Press on Ball, then Single-Leg Standing Cable Press, starting from 0; climb a rung after 2 sessions in a row with every set done and solid form, up to rung 2
Reads your form rating (rated after the session).
Starts with rung = 0; written by session, owner.
Starts with solid sessions in a row = 0; written by session.

Plan: The item at position your rung (from 0) of [Push-Up, Hands on Stability Ball, then Alternating DB Chest Press on Ball, then Single-Leg Standing Cable Press] (holding at the last): 2 sets of 12 reps to 20 reps at tempo 4-2-1-0.

After each session:
    - if every working set reached its target:
      - if your form rating is at least formQuality 2 (no if unknown):
        - if your solid sessions in a row plus 1 is at least 2: Set rung to (your rung plus 1), capped at 2; set solid sessions in a row to 0.
        - otherwise: Raise solid sessions in a row by 1.
      - otherwise: Set solid sessions in a row to 0.
    - if a working set fell short: Set solid sessions in a row to 0.
    - if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: Leave everything as is.
